definition.en: The Economic Survey on Agriculture is an official annual document released by the Ministry of Finance that analyzes the performance, structural challenges, capital formation, and policy framework of the agricultural sector within the Indian Economy.
definition.hi: The Economic Survey on Agriculture is an official annual document released by the Ministry of Finance that analyzes the performance, structural challenges, capital formation, and policy framework of the agricultural sector within the Indian Economy.

importanceInUpsc.en: For UPSC Prelims and Mains GS-3 (Indian Economy and Agriculture), this topic provides critical data, policy evaluations, and analytical insights regarding crop diversification, food security, credit flow, and budgetary allocations required for structured analytical answers.
importanceInUpsc.hi: For UPSC Prelims and Mains GS-3 (Indian Economy and Agriculture), this topic provides critical data, policy evaluations, and analytical insights regarding crop diversification, food security, credit flow, and budgetary allocations required for structured analytical answers.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the macroeconomic role of agriculture in the Indian Economy as analyzed by the Economic Survey.
